recognize_zh: 低倍皮膚切片表皮完整，真皮全層被瀰漫、密集的單一圓形細胞浸潤取代，腫瘤細胞在膠原束之間穿插生長、並未侵入表皮；這種瀰漫性真皮浸潤需搭配高倍型態與免疫染色才能判定為骨髓肉瘤。
features: Dense, diffuse sheet-like infiltrate of monotonous small-to-medium round cells filling the dermis
Tumor cells dissect between residual collagen bundles, more visible in the deep dermis
Infiltrate extends up to the papillary dermis beneath the epidermis
Low magnification; cytologic details such as nucleoli and mitoses not assessable
describe_en: Skin biopsy at low power shows an intact epidermis overlying a dense, diffuse infiltrate that effaces the dermis. The infiltrate is composed of monotonous small to medium round cells growing in sheets and splaying residual collagen bundles, extending up to the papillary dermis without epidermal involvement. Adnexal structures are not apparent in this field. The pattern indicates a diffuse dermal hematolymphoid or blastic infiltrate; with higher-power blastic cytology and myeloid immunophenotype, the findings are consistent with myeloid sarcoma (leukemia cutis).

ddx.vs: BPDCN produces an identical diffuse dermal infiltrate sparing the epidermis, so CD4, CD56, CD123, TCF4 positivity with MPO negativity is required to separate it.

ddx.dx: Primary cutaneous diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, leg type
ddx.vs: DLBCL leg type is composed of large centroblasts/immunoblasts that are CD20, BCL2, and MUM1 positive and MPO negative.

ddx.dx: Mycosis fungoides or other cutaneous T-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: MF typically shows epidermotropism with atypical lymphocytes in the epidermis, which is absent here.
Merkel cell carcinoma forms dermal sheets of small blue cells but is CK20 dot-positive and neuroendocrine marker positive.
